Privacy Policy

Your Privacy on TalkNow

Last updated: November 2026. We believe the safest data is the data that is never stored.

1. Zero Account Architecture

TalkNow never asks for your email address, full name, phone number, password, or third-party OAuth logins. Your display name is temporary and exists only within the memory of the room you join.

2. Ephemeral Data & Deletion Policy

Every room has a strict expiry duration (30 minutes, 1 hour, 6 hours, or 24 hours). Once a room expires or is manually closed by its creator:

  • The room cannot accept any new members or messages.
  • All chat messages, timestamps, and member records are automatically purged by automated cleanup jobs.
  • No backups or archives of message history are preserved.

3. Security & Link Secrecy

Room links are generated using cryptographically secure random entropy to prevent enumeration or scanning. Only people with whom you deliberately share the link can access the room while it is active. We do not claim end-to-end encryption; messages are encrypted in transit over HTTPS and WebSockets.

4. Cookies and Local Storage

TalkNow uses zero tracking or analytics cookies. We use temporary session tokens solely to keep your socket connection authenticated while you are in a room.
